provenance.notes: Real Docker verification with official grafana/grafana-oss images (8.3.0/8.3.1/8.3.2). Recipe-based: images pulled at up-time, canary planted in environment via compose entrypoint. Gate run 2026-07-10 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate`; see repro.log. CVE-2021-43798 unauth /public/plugins/ traversal reads canary on 8.3.0 (HTTP 200) and is blocked on 8.3.1 (HTTP 404); CVE-2021-43813 authenticated /api/plugins/:id/markdown/ traversal (sibling endpoint the 43798 fix left unclamped) reads canary on 8.3.1 (HTTP 200), closed on 8.3.2 (returns plugin's own README, no canary). Grafana explicitly frames 43813 as a follow-up to 43798 = genuine incomplete fix. Note: residual requires an authenticated user (admin/admin basic auth) and is limited to .md files, whereas the original seed is unauthenticated and arbitrary-file.

audit.evidence: Live regate on real Docker (official grafana/grafana-oss:8.3.0/8.3.1/8.3.2). Canary .md planted at /tmp/pcb_canary.md outside all served roots. Gate passed via HTTP: CVE-2021-43798 plugin-path traversal flag@v0, blocked@v1 (8.3.1), residual CVE-2021-43813 markdown-endpoint traversal flag@v1 (admin/admin basic auth), residual blocked@v2 (8.3.2, 200 no flag). Real grafana app.
